But across Europe people are waking up to this secret. 

We know that if enough of us learn about this, and take action, we can win. We’ve done it before. Last year, we opposed a treaty that let corporations sue countries for taking climate action. And we won!

But some of the worst companies still exploit this loophole to get what they want. 

Let’s be the roar that brings this scandal to the news. If we expose these secret courts we can get rid of them for good!

Protect Greenland from Trump's grip!

To President Ursula von der Leyen, High Representative for Foreign Affairs Kaja Kallas, and all Members of the European Commission and European Parliament.

Petition

We urge you to take a firm stance in defending Greenland’s sovereignty and its people’s right to shape their own future.

The EU must support Greenland and its citizens in resisting any attempts at annexation or coercion by:

  • Strengthening fair partnerships with the EU,
  • Promoting sustainable development,
  • Recognising and respecting Greenland as a key partner in the Arctic region.

Why is this important?

Trump is charging ahead with his plan to buy Greenland - and threatening military action if their leaders refuse. [1]

Greenlanders have made one thing clear: their democracy is not for sale. [2] Yet White House staff are telling media outlets they’re “discussing an offer”. They’ve even hinted that refusing their deal could mean they take military action - just like they have in Venezuela and Iran. [3]

Greenland’s independence, resources, and fragile environment are at stake. Trump continues to show disregard for the climate, withdrawing the US from treaties and commitments. [4] Under his agenda, the Arctic ecosystem faces destruction.

This is not just an insult to Europe’s democracy; it’s a direct threat to Greenland’s people. Local communities risk losing their voice and control over their future, alongside their lands, full of rare minerals and vital for the green transition. 

After the latest developments, decision-makers are no longer ignoring Trump’s plan. Eight European leaders signed a statement in solidarity with Greenlanders. [5] But solidarity means nothing without action. But words alone won’t protect Greenland. 

Now is the time for bold, decisive action to defend Greenland’s sovereignty and the Arctic’s future.

Demand the EU stand firm: defend Greenland’s sovereignty, protect the Arctic’s fragile environment, and safeguard democracy across Europe.

Deutscher Fußball-Bund (Germany), Federação Portuguesa de Futebol (Portugal), Fédération Française de Football (France), Federazione Italiana Giuoco Calcio (Italy), Hrvatski nogometni savez (Croatia), Koninklijke Belgische Voetbalbond / Union Royale Belge des Sociétés de Football-Association (Belgium), Koninklijke Nederlandse Voetbalbond (The Netherlands), Norges Fotballforbund (Norway), Österreichischer Fußball-Bund (Austria), Polski Związek Piłki Nożnej (Poland), Real Federación Española de Fútbol (Spain), Schweizerischer Fussballverband / Association Suisse de Football (Switzerland), Scottish Football Association (Scotland), The Football Association (England)

Petition

We call on you to:

  • Demand that FIFA moves any World Cup matches due to be played in the US to alternative host countries.
  • Pledge to boycott any matches not moved out of the US, in order to ensure the safety and security of all players and fans, regardless of their ethnicity or country of origin.

Why is this important?

There seems to be no red line Trump won’t cross. 

One day he threatens to invade Greenland. Next, he defends ICE agents murdering protesters in the streets. [1] 

This summer the men’s football World Cup will be co-hosted by the US, Canada and Mexico. 

But a country, like the US, that attacks protesters and snatches innocent people off the streets cannot ensure the safety of players and fans. Supporters from countries on Trump’s travel ban list - like Senegal, Ivory Coast, Iran and Haiti - won’t even be allowed to enter the US to support their teams. [2]

There’s an easy solution. Canada and Mexico are co-hosts. The matches planned for the US - including the big final - could and should be played there instead or in alternative host countries that can ensure the safety of all fans and players.  

The global football governing body, FIFA has the final say. But national football associations like have huge power. [3]

Together we can turn up the pressure on them to take a stand: boycott any matches played in the US, unless they are moved. Add your name now to ensure the World Cup is a place that welcomes all fans and players.

Yet destructive industries and foreign interests, including the United States, want politicians to kill it. Many European leaders are giving in. They are ready to cut protections designed to defend nature, and our health.

European leaders: protect forests, protect people and enforce the EUDR.

Why is this important?

We have a real chance. The European Commission’s President, Ursula von der Leyen, can protect the EUDR from pressure by EU capitals and industry to sacrifice even more forests. She can stand behind her law.  

The Commission President cares about her reputation. Strong and visible citizens’ support will give her the political strength to reclaim control over this landmark law and ensure it fulfils its purpose: protecting the world’s forests.  

The people’s movement for forests has urgently called on our community to act. We demand that Ursula von der Leyen show courageous leadership and stand firmly in defence of nature. The greater the public support, the stronger the chances of protecting this law.

Save the Digital Euro

To the national governments of the Eurozone, the European Parliament, the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs (ECON), and the European Commission

Petition

We call on you to create a Digital Euro that:

  1. Simplifies transactions between people within Europe.
  2. Gives all Europeans access to a digital form of public money — alongside cash — with a generous holding limit, so it can become a credible alternative to private money issued by commercial banks.
  3. Enables Europe’s independence from foreign payment providers.
  4. Acts as a foundation of a sovereign and resilient European payment infrastructure, following the highest privacy standards.

Do not lower the ambitions of the Digital Euro project under pressure from banks and Big Tech. Ensure it serves people above profits.

Why is this important?

Imagine this: groceries in hand, you tap your card to pay. Denied. No access to your money. 

It sounds unthinkable, but Europe almost entirely relies on US companies to handle digital payments. If political pressure rises in the US, access to our money could be restricted overnight. [1]

There is a way out: Europe’s own digital money.

A digital euro: backed by our central bank, accessible to everyone. Even without a private bank account. Free from foreign interference. After years of preparation, a strong proposal is now on the table. 

And that’s exactly why banks and Big Tech are panicking. They’re pushing hard to weaken the digital euro to protect their profits and US companies like MasterCard and PayPal. 

Now, Members of the European Parliament — elected to represent us — are discussing the proposal. And when thousands of people speak up at once, they feel the pressure and act accordingly.

If we stay silent, the banks and Big Tech win. So let’s send a message to our MEPs they can’t ignore: Europeans must control their own money.

Tell your MEP today: Save the digital euro. Don’t give in to banks and Big Tech.

Safe abortion care for all women

To the European Commission, especially the European Commission’s President, Ursula von der Leyen and Commissioner for Equality, Hadja Lahbib.

We ask you to publicly and actively support the My Voice, My Choice initiative, ensuring safe, affordable, and accessible abortion care across all EU Member States.

Why is this important?

Women across Europe are asking for your help.

Next Thursday, the European Commission will make a final decision on the My Voice, My Choice initiative - the movement fighting to guarantee safe, affordable and accessible abortion care for all women in Europe. [1]

Right now, safe abortion access depends on where you live, how much money you have, the government that rules your country and whether you can travel away from it. 

For many women across Europe, this means there are insurmountable barriers preventing real choice over their own bodies. It means pain, silence and fear.

My Voice, My Choice has carried this fight for all women across borders for many years - and now they’ve asked the WeMove Europe community to help with one final push. We need Commissioners to feel the strength of public support, asking them to lead the way towards a new era for reproductive and women’s rights in Europe.

They asked for our help because they know that EU decision-makers listen to us. That they take our opinion into account. That we have won battles in the past, and we will do it again.

Because this decision isn’t just words on paper. It’s about our dignity. The safety of millions of human beings. And the simple truth that healthcare - including abortion care - should never depend on luck.

Sign now to support My Voice My Choice!

2026-02-trial-child-detention-petition-E.title: Children need care, not prison bars!
2026-02-trial-child-detention-petition-E.description_full:
Children need care, not prison bars!

To the European Commission, European Parliament, and Ministry of the Interior and Administration of Poland

Petition

We are calling on the European Commission, European Parliament, and Polish authorities to:

  1. Immediately revoke the provisions that allow detention of unaccompanied minors in closed immigration centers.

  2. Ensure that children seeking international protection are placed in care suited to their needs - family or appropriate care facilities - not detention.

  3. Bring Polish law into alignment with EU law and international standards that regard child detention as a measure which should be avoided entirely.

Why is this important?

A haunting image from the United States went viral - a boy wearing a school backpack and a bunny‑ears hat being locked up by immigration officers. [1]

But the same thing can now happen in Poland - almost unnoticed, without public debate, without warning.

A new law pushed quietly allows the Polish authorities to lock up children who ask for asylum. Teenagers who fled the war and violence can be sent to closed migration centers surrounded by fences and guards. These are not shelters. They are basically prisons. [2]

Before this law passed, these children were placed in foster families. Now, instead of safety and care, they face months or even years behind bars, simply for seeking protection. Detention trauma drives children to depression and suicide attempts. [3]

When cruelty is hidden, it can spread. When it’s exposed, it can be stopped. You can help shine a light on this secret. 

This is about defending children - they should be protected, not locked up in prison. 

Demand that the EU step in and stop Poland from breaking European law and violating children’s rights!

To the Department of Public Security of Milan

Petition

We demand that the Department of Public Security of Milan:

  • Refuse any authorisation for ICE agents to operate on Italian soil;
  • Protect public safety by keeping foreign enforcement agencies off our streets;
  • Ensure that Italy does not open the door to ICE operations across Europe.

Why is this important?

ICE is coming to Europe. [1] 

You read right. Trump’s thugs - the ones who shoot innocent people on America’s streets and arrest 5 year old children on their way home from kindergarten - could be on our soil. [2]

In just four days, US ICE agents could arrive in Italy for the Winter Olympics.  
They call it “security”. What we see are guns and masked faces. [3]

Italy’s Prime Minister, Giorgia Meloni, one of Trump’s closest allies in Europe, is letting this happen. While ICE is under fire in the US, she smiles beside Trump and waves his agents into Europe. And our leaders stand by. [4] If ICE is allowed in now, it sets a precedent that won’t end in Italy. 

We, the people, say: not here, not now, not ever. 

That’s why we are speaking directly to the Department of Public Security of Milan - the police officials responsible for the security decisions that determine who is allowed to operate on our streets. 

Even Milan’s Mayor has said no - yet the decision is still being pushed through. [5] Security decisions are made behind closed doors unless the public shows up. Police leadership are rarely targeted - that’s exactly why this moment matters. Add your name now - before time runs out!

Europe: Stand up against illegal war in Iran

To the EU, the leaders of European countries and the UK

Petition

We call on you to:

  • Publicly call out the US and Israel’s war in Iran as illegal according to international law.
  • Refuse to let the US use military bases in Europe for their attacks on Iran

Why is this important?

“We’re heading to World War III”. That’s a direct quote from a respected economist - a man not known to exaggerate. [1]

Trump and Netanyahu are carpet-bombing Tehran. A city of more than 10 million people. Over a hundred children were killed after a US bomb targeted their school. [2] 

Europe is one of the few world powers strong enough to stand up to the US. And while people overwhelmingly do not want this war, our leaders look on. Scared of getting on Trump’s bad side. [3] 

But there is hope. Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has called the attacks on Iran what they are: a “reckless and illegal” war. He has even refused to let the US use military bases in Spain. [4] 

Other European countries need to follow suit. Some leaders have shown signs of wanting to do so, but they need to hear from us, the public. 

Together, let’s push our leaders to stand against Trump and Netanyahu’s illegal war - and refuse to let the US use military bases in Europe for their deadly attacks. For each day that the threat of world war is nearer, our silence has a greater cost.

Say No to Palantir in Europe

To European governments and the EU

Petition

We call on European governments to: 

  • Stop signing new contracts with Palantir.
  • Review and phase out existing contracts with the company.
  • Invest in transparent, publicly accountable European alternatives.

And we call on the EU to urgently investigate Palantir’s use across Europe, ensure full transparency over contracts and data use, and push governments to halt new deals until strong safeguards and democratic oversight are guaranteed.

Europe must not hand its public systems, data, and security to a private US surveillance company, especially one that is involved in fueling wars and mass deportations. 

Why is this important?

A powerful company enables genocide in Gaza, helps ICE separate families, and fuels Trump’s war with Iran. [1]

Most people have never even heard of it.

But governments across Europe are quietly signing contracts with it, paid for with our tax money. [2] Its name is Palantir.

From the UK to Germany to France and beyond, governments are handing this US spy-tech giant access to sensitive public systems and data. Police in Germany use it to track suspects, the UK hands it vast healthcare datasets - and this is just the beginning. [3]

Palantir’s influence in Europe is spreading fast, largely out of public sight.

That’s exactly why we must shine a light on it. Otherwise, we risk expanding mass surveillance and fuelling wars, while Europe hands its data and security to a US spy-tech giant.

If we build momentum to expose Palantir, we can push leaders to stop signing new contracts and protect Europe’s public systems from powerful surveillance giants.

Add your name now to demand transparency and stop the expansion of Palantir in Europe.

2026-03-trial-authoritarianism-petition-.description_full:
Fund peace not war

To the European Commission, European Parliament and Council of the European Union

Petition

We want a Europe that invests in peace, people and the planet, not destruction. 

We demand that our leaders spend the billions destined for weapons on essential services instead; from pensions to schools, to healthcare, to safe food and housing. 

Europeans do not want to fund efforts of regime change anywhere in the world. We believe in the right for people to determine their own futures and to that end - leave Venezuela to the Venezuelans and Iran to the Iranians. 

Why is this important?

A bomb targeting a girls school. Over 100 children were murdered. In the name of security. [1]

This is not a dystopian future. It’s happening right now in Iran with the United States in the driver's seat.

Under Trump, “security” first meant violence at home - armed agents deployed into cities and brutally murdering protesters, including a nurse and a prize-winning poet. [2] And now it’s violence across the globe. [3] 

This is how authoritarianism creeps in. Not all at once. But step by step. Always justified in the name of security.

In Europe, if fear is allowed to drive political decisions, we could face the same outcome.Across the EU, leaders have openly been talking about war, and conscription. Military budgets are rising fast. and today, only one of them has condemned the attacks on Iran. [4]

We are told military expansion will make us safer. But history tells us something else. And all of this is happening while people struggle to afford housing, our healthcare remains underfunded, and the cost-of-living crisis deepens.

If we do not want authoritarianism to take root in Europe, we must not give in to fear.
We must not accept militarisation as the answer to the crisis.

More than a decade ago, millions of people across Europe refused to stay silent as leaders marched toward war. Now it’s our turn.  Let’s build the biggest pro-peace and democracy movement in a generation. Add your name to join people across Europe demanding protection for people not money for more weapons.

Fund Renewables, Not War

To the European Commission, European Parliament and Council of the European Union

Petition

We want a Europe that invests in peace, people, and the planet - not in war and fossil fuels.

Ordinary people shouldn’t pay the price while corporations and warmongers profit. Europe must stop funding illegal wars and instead invest in stable, homegrown renewable energy that protects households, communities, and our future.

Add your name to demand leaders choose peace and clean energy.

Why is this important?

Toxic rain falls from the sky. Black smoke fills the air. [1] 

These aren’t scenes from a sci-fi movie. They’re scenes from Iran. Where Trump and Israel have started another war none of us want. 

For every bomb dropped, innocent people pay the price with their lives. And then there are those who cash in. 

Shell, Total, and warmongers like Trump. And it’s you and I who foot the bill with higher bills for energy, food and fuel across Europe. [2]

As long as Europe relies on foreign oil and gas tied to conflict, our energy costs will stay out of our control.

But there’s a solution. Europe can invest in stable, homegrown renewable energy. Even Europe's leaders, from Starmer to Von der Leyen who backpedalled on climate protections, are considering it. [3] These are tipping points when mass public pressure can make bold action possible. 

EU leaders are meeting this week to decide how to respond to soaring prices. [4] Your voice can push them to choose clean, reliable energy over fossil fuels and price spikes.

Add your name to demand energy that is safe, affordable, and under our control - not dictated by conflicts thousands of miles away.

US and Israel are carpet-bombing Teheran. A city of over 10 million people.[2] Over a hundred children are dead after a US bomb fell on their school. Trump and Netanyahu’s thirst for power is putting the lives, homes and safety of millions at risk.

Spanish prime minister Pedro Sánchez has been celebrated for calling the attacks on Iran what they are: a “reckless and illegal” war. He has even refused to let the US use military bases in Spain. [3] 

Other European countries need to follow suit. Across Europe, people overwhelmingly do not want this war. [4] 

We can make our leaders hear this message: stand against Trump’s illegal war in Iran - and refuse to let the US use military bases in Europe for their deadly attacks.

2026-03-trial-landmines-trial-EN-petitio.title: Protect civilians - keep landmines banned!
2026-03-trial-landmines-trial-EN-petitio.description_full:
Protect civilians - keep landmines banned!

To the European Union and Member States

Petition

We call on:

The five countries that have withdrawn from the Mine Ban Convention (Estonia, Finland, Latvia, Lithuania, and Poland) to:

  • Immediately halt all plans for the production, procurement and use of antipersonnel mines
  • Publicly commit to not deploying antipersonnel mines

All EU Member States to:

  • Uphold the Mine Ban Convention and its norms
  • Actively discourage fellow EU Member States from producing, procuring, or using antipersonnel mines
  • Reaffirm their commitment to civilian protection and international humanitarian law

The European Union to:

  • Ensure that no European Commission funding (including SAFE loans) is used for the production, stockpiling, or deployment of antipersonnel mines
  • Actively defend and promote the Mine Ban Convention, both within the EU and globally

Why is this important?

“We’re in a position to mine any border within 48 hours.” [1]

Read that again.

Polish leadership said they need just forty-eight hours to bring back a weapon the world banned after decades of effort.

As EU leaders clash over Ukraine funding and accuse each other of betrayal, a deeply dangerous decision is taking shape beneath the political drama: bringing landmines back to Europe.

Poland is preparing for large-scale production. Finland is already planning to train troops to use them. And in Germany, political voices are beginning to suggest abandoning the ban altogether. [2]

This is how it starts. Not with one big decision, but many small steps, happening in the shadows of bigger crises. A global norm that took decades to agree is beginning to unravel.

Landmines don’t stop wars. They stay in the ground for decades - killing civilians long after conflicts end.

But the ban hasn’t been lifted yet. Countries like Germany and Sweden are still debating their path. The European Union can still act to uphold the ban.

This is how disasters are averted: when people like you and me speak out early - before decisions harden and before production begins at scale. Add your voice before this quiet shift becomes a permanent one!

800 billion euros. No, that’s not a typo.

National leaders decide on their defense spending. But when the EU encourages them to spend more on weapons, they listen. 

Tell your representatives: Europe needs budgets that protect people — not prepare for war.

2026-03-trial-palantir-petition-EN.title: Say No to Palantir in Europe
2026-03-trial-palantir-petition-EN.description_full:
Say No to Palantir in Europe

To all European governments and the European Union

Petition

We call on European governments and the EU to:

  • Stop signing new contracts with Palantir.
  • Review and phase out existing contracts with the company.
  • Protect public data and democratic oversight of security systems.
  • Invest in transparent, publicly accountable European alternatives.

Europe must not hand its public systems, data, and security to a private US surveillance company, especially one that is involved in fueling wars and mass deportations.

Why is this important?

A powerful company enables genocide in Gaza, helps ICE separate families, and fuels Trump’s war with Iran. [1]

Most people have never even heard of it.

But governments across Europe are quietly signing contracts with it, paid for with our tax money. [2] Its name is Palantir.

From the UK to Germany to France and beyond, governments are handing this US spy-tech giant access to sensitive public systems and data. Police in Germany use it to track suspects, the UK hands it vast healthcare datasets - and this is just the beginning .[3]

Palantir’s influence in Europe is spreading fast, largely out of public sight.

That’s exactly why we must shine a light on it. Otherwise, we risk expanding mass surveillance and fuelling wars, while Europe hands its data and security to a US spy-tech giant.

If we build momentum to expose Palantir, we can push leaders to stop signing new contracts and protect Europe’s public systems from powerful surveillance giants.

Add your name now to demand transparency and stop the expansion of Palantir in Europe.

2026-03-trial-social-media-age-limit-tri.description_full:
Keep our kids safe online

To the European Commission, European Parliament and EU Heads of State.

Petition

Every child should be able to grow up safe - both offline and online.

But right now, social media platforms are designed to keep children scrolling, not to protect their wellbeing.

We are calling on EU leaders to step in and protect children from harmful online design.

We are calling for:

  • Strong EU-wide rules to protect children online, preventing exposure to harmful or age-inappropriate content
  • Limits on addictive platform design, including infinite scroll, autoplay, and engagement-driven feeds
  • Stronger safeguards for algorithmic feeds, so children are not pushed towards harmful or extreme content
  • Clear responsibility for platforms to protect children, not just maximise screen time or profit
  • Real enforcement when platforms fail to keep children safe, with meaningful penalties when harm occurs.

Why is this important?

Protecting kids online feels impossible. But now, things are changing - fast.

Courts are finally ruling against companies like Meta and YouTube. Governments across Europe are proposing age limits and tighter rules. [1]

For the first time, Big Tech is being held accountable.

Because the problem has been clear for years: social media companies designed their platforms to keep kids hooked. Infinite scroll. Autoplay. Algorithms. For children and teenagers, whose brains are still developing, these features can be impossible to resist. 

The consequences are devastating. Bullying on social media follows kids into their homes, long after school ends. Content drags them into eating disorders or self-harm spirals. [2] 

Social media is built to maximise profit, not safety. Some countries are finally taking it seriously and considering bans. [3]

But experts and evidence warns that banning specific social media platforms will just send them to other online spaces. [4] Unless platforms like TikTok and Meta are made safer by design, with EU-wide rules, enforcement, and monitoring, kids will be exposed to the same harm wherever they go. 

Hundreds of thousands of parents and citizens are already speaking up. [5] And now, with the courts on our side, people power can push Europe to go further - and force platforms to finally put children’s safety before profit.

Will you add your voice to make social media safer for kids?

2026-03-trial-toxic-landfills-petition-E.title: End the toxic landfill crisis in Europe
2026-03-trial-toxic-landfills-petition-E.description_full:
End the toxic landfill crisis in Europe

To the European Commission, European Parliament, European Environment Agency

Petition

We call on you to:

  1. Establish an EU-wide, publicly accessible database of all the landfill sites, with risk assessments
  2. Require systematic testing at all identified landfills and enforce actions to prevent contamination of groundwater and surface water
  3. Amend the Landfill Directive and Drinking Water Directive to close regulatory gaps
  4. Establish dedicated EU funding to support member states and local authorities in safely remediating high-risk landfills

Why is this important?

Thousands of forgotten landfill sites lie beneath our fields, forests and playgrounds across Europe. Now, many of them are leaking toxic waste into our rivers and the water we drink.

A shocking new investigation revealed the location of 60,000 old landfills in the UK, France, Italy, Spain and other countries in Europe. [1] Some of them are already releasing heavy metals, arsenic and “forever chemicals”. 

These landfills poison us. Communities unknowingly drink contaminated water. Farmers grow food on polluted land. Wildlife is exposed to chemicals that never break down.

There is no complete EU map of where all toxic sites are and no systematic monitoring. Worst of all - there's no coordinated plan to clean them up.

We have an opportunity right now to change this. The EU’s Landfill Directive is scheduled for review this year - a rare moment when rules can be strengthened. 

Together we can tell EU leaders we know the damage these landfills are doing. We can force them to ensure toxic landfills are finally monitored, and prevent decades-old waste from poisoning our communities.

References:

  1. https://www.investigate-europe.eu/posts/europes-toxic-landfill-crisis-exposed-in-groundbreaking-mapping-project

2026-03-veto-power-trial-EN.title: Five countries shouldn’t control global peace
2026-03-veto-power-trial-EN.description_full:
Five countries shouldn’t control global peace

To the United Nations Assembly, and to European governments

Petition

We call on world leaders to reform the United Nations Security Council by limiting or abolishing the veto power of its permanent members, and to make global peace and security decisions more democratic.

Specifically, we urge governments to:

  • Support initiatives to restrict the use of the veto, especially in cases of mass atrocities and war crimes
  • Promote UN Charter reform to ensure fairer global representation
  • Work towards a Security Council that can act effectively to prevent conflict and protect civilians

Why is this important?

“How is it possible that Russia and the U.S. remain permanent members of the Security Council? Both countries bring instability to the world with the wars in Ukraine and Iran.”

Not my words, but European leader Pedro Sánchez’s.

Right now, only five countries hold veto power in the UN Security Council, including the U.S and Russia.

This is the reason why bombs fall and people lose their loved ones to violence and torture; and why we live in fear of a total war. 

The UN Security Council is an old remnant from World War II when 5 countries (out of 193!) self-granted the authority to decide the fate of peace and war on Earth.  

But now Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez is publicly calling for a more democratic global system - raising concerns about how decisions on war and peace are made. [1]

With hundreds of thousands of people mobilising against war and Sánchez’s call for common sense, this is the right time to finally leave behind an outdated world order.

Let’s tell other European leaders to join Sánchez in his call for common sense - and most importantly, peace.

2026-04-08-trial-climate-protections-cor.title: Keep making polluters pay
2026-04-08-trial-climate-protections-cor.description_full:
Keep making polluters pay

To the European Parliament, European Commission, and EU Member State governments

Petition

Big polluters and their corporate lobbyists are attacking one of the EU’s most important climate policies: the Emissions Trading System.

They’ve succeeded at delaying the launch of the second phase of this scheme to make pollution more expensive. Worse, they’ve blocked billions of euros in support that should be helping people deal with higher energy and transport costs. 

What needs to be done: 

  • End fossil privileges. Stop delaying the introduction of the carbon price for road transport and buildings (ETS2), and don’t water it down.
  • Invest in real, lasting solutions. Every Euro counts to make homes warmer, communities healthier, and clean transportation affordable.
  • Put climate money to work for people. Expand the EU’s Social Climate Fund so support reaches those who need it most.

Why is this important?

What do Lufthansa, Air France, Shell, Gazprom, and Repsol have in common?

They all choose profits over people, polluting Europe while pocketing as much money as they can. They are not alone. Most companies won’t step away from fossil fuels, unless we make them. 

When corporations in the energy, aviation and shipping industries were put into a ‘dirty industries pay’ scheme, things turned around. Their emissions halved! [1]

But now this successful scheme is to be expanded to other sectors, its enemies have put their well-oiled propaganda machines at work. A few days ago, they called for it to be weakened and postponed for years.

A handful of countries are championing the ‘dirty industries pay’ scheme but many others are pushing to shelve it indefinitely. [2]  With the final decision looming, we must urgently give more weight to those defending the scheme.

Together, we can call out corporate cronies and force governments to choose people over pollution. If we remain silent, the likes of Repsol, Eni or Total will continue to profit while polluting Europe. Take a minute to take action for a cleaner future!

References:

2026-04-19-trial-equal-pay-gap-trial-pet.title: No more lower paychecks for women!
2026-04-19-trial-equal-pay-gap-trial-pet.description_full:
No more lower paychecks for women!

To Commissioner for Equality Hadja Lahbib and Commissioner for Economy and Productivity; Implementation and Simplification, Valdis Dombrovskis

Petition

We call on you to fully protect the integrity and ambition of the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

Specifically, we urge the Commission to:

  • Reject any attempt to weaken or delay the implementation of pay transparency rules through the upcoming “Omnibus” simplification package or related initiatives.
  • Keep strong requirements on salary transparency, reporting obligations, and enforcement mechanisms for companies.
  • Ensure that all workers across the EU can access clear, comparable information about pay levels and pay gaps within their workplace.
  • Safeguard the right of workers to be informed about pay ranges and to challenge unjustified pay differences without retaliation.

At a time when gender equality is still far from reality, the EU must not give in to pressure from corporate lobby groups seeking to keep pay discrimination hidden.

Why is this important?

Would you accept working for free? Probably not.

On average, women earn around 11% less than men. That’s like working for free for one month every year. [1]

At this pace, this pay gap would be closed by 2104. [2]

But the EU has a new law to shine a light on what happens behind closed doors. [3] For the first time, workers would be able to see pay ranges. Companies would have to report their gender pay gaps. And unequal pay could no longer be quietly hidden away.

Because inequality survives in silence, and transparency breaks that silence.

Now, just as this law is about to make a real difference, powerful corporate lobby groups are trying to water it down. To keep pay secret and their reputation clean. [4]

If they succeed, the law will lose its power before people even get to feel it.

This is a rare moment where change is actually within reach.

This law is supposed to be adopted by all member states in a few weeks from now. For every day it's delayed, it means more women working for free, and more risk for it to be weakened until useless.

Sign today to conquer equal pay for all!

2026-04-19-trial-manure-in-drinnking-wat.title: Don’t let profiteering turn our tap water toxic
2026-04-19-trial-manure-in-drinnking-wat.description_full:
Don’t let profiteering turn our tap water toxic

To the European Commission and to Member States

Petition

More than 30% of EU surface waters and over 80% of marine waters are already eutrophic, while 14% of groundwater breaches drinking water limits.

We call on EU leaders to:

  • Immediately reverse the decision to loosen manure application rules
  • Enforce and strengthen the Nitrates Directive
  • Support farmers to transition to reduce animal stocking densities and to shift to low-input, agroecological farming.


Europe’s water is for people - it’s not a dumping ground.

Why is this important?

Every sip you take could be contaminated.

Toxic waste from industrial farming is leaking, drop by drop, into our water. Manure and sprayed chemicals travel through soil into rivers - and they end up in our glasses. [1]

The result: ‘blue babies’, cancer, cardiovascular diseases. [2]

For years industrial farming lobbyists sat beside Commissioners, putting pressure on them to protect profits, instead of people.

Now, corporations have attacked again, making standards lower - letting more manure and chemicals into our drinking water.

This is an attack on our water and our health. One citizens group has launched a legal investigation to challenge this decision. [3] But, unless we use people’s power to show our support, it could go unheard. 

That’s precisely why you and I are part of this community: our voices can surface this important issue from the shadows.

Legal action is just the start. In the past, our community filed a complaint on violations of migrant’s rights, backed it with public pressure - and won! [4]

The window to protect our drinking water is closing fast. If enough of us join, we’ll stand up to the corporations to blame. Are you in?

2026-04-anti-slapps-petition-EN.description_full:

Protect people, not corporate bullies

To all governments of the European Union

Petition

We call on European governments to urgently and fully transpose the EU Anti-SLAPP Directive into strong national laws that actually protect people:

  • Guarantee full legal protection of people who engage in public participation against all SLAPPs, whether or not they are cross-border, and regardless of the legal basis (criminal, civil or administrative).
  • Ensure fast dismissal of abusive cases, legal aid and financial compensation for victims, and real penalties for those who abuse the courts

Why is this important?

Greenpeace just went to court in the Netherlands to defend themselves. Their crime? Trying to stop a massive oil pipeline from destroying nature. [1]

And now, they’re being sued for millions by the very fossil fuel giant they fought. This is not an isolated case. Big Oil attacks on the public are increasing. [2] 

Thankfully the EU already has a law that protects Greenpeace - and all of us. [3] Lawsuits where corporations armed with deep pockets and ruthless corporate lawyers take everyday people to court for stopping bad stuff from happening. 

But until our leaders implement the law people are defenceless against Big Bullies. And our governments are dragging their feet. [4] Some don’t want to implement the law. Others are happy to do it sloppily and avoid confronting the corporations that fund them. 

Because this is about all our freedoms and right to speak up: to speak truth to those in power.

Sign now to avoid governments stall this protection. If enough of us speak up today, they can’t quietly delay or dilute this law. 

Tell them: Shield civil society from corporate bullies!

2026-04-ban-landmines-europe-petition-EN.title: Protect civilians - keep landmines banned
2026-04-ban-landmines-europe-petition-EN.description_full:
English

  • Français
  • Deutsch
  • Español
  • Italiano

Protect civilians - keep landmines banned

To the European Union and the Member States

Petition

We call on:

The five countries that have withdrawn from the Mine Ban Convention (Estonia, Finland, Latvia, Lithuania, and Poland) to:

- Immediately halt all plans for the production, procurement and use of antipersonnel mines
- Publicly commit to not deploying antipersonnel mines

All EU Member States to:

- Uphold the Mine Ban Convention and its norms
- Actively discourage fellow EU Member States from producing, procuring, or using antipersonnel mines
- Reaffirm their commitment to civilian protection and international humanitarian law

The European Union to:

- Ensure that no European Commission funding (including SAFE loans) is used for the production, stockpiling, or deployment of antipersonnel mines
- Actively defend and promote the Mine Ban Convention, both within the EU and globally

Why is this important?

“We’re in a position to mine any border within 48 hours.” [1] Read that again.

The Polish leadership said they need just forty-eight hours to bring back a weapon the world banned decades ago. A weapon that cost us thousands of lives, destroyed and lost. [2]

They are trying to bring landmines back to Europe.

Poland is preparing for large-scale production. Finland is already planning to train troops to use them. And in Germany, political voices are beginning to suggest abandoning the ban altogether. [3]

Landmines stay in the ground - killing people long after conflicts end. Survivors face amputations, permanent disabilities, and trauma. Their victims are kids walking to school, families travelling by car, or farmers using tractors. [4]

But the ban is still in place. Countries like Sweden are still deciding. The European Union can still uphold the ban.

This is how disasters are averted: when people like you and me speak out early - before decisions harden and before production begins at scale. Add your voice before this quiet shift becomes a permanent one!

We call on European governments to transpose the EU Anti-SLAPP (“Strategic Lawsuit Against Public Participation”) Directive into national law to:

Some don’t want to implement the law. Others are happy to do it sloppily and avoid confronting the corporations that fund them. 

Because this is about all our freedoms and right to speak up: to speak truth to the ones in power.

There are only a few weeks left. Sign now before governments stall this protection. If enough of us speak up, they can’t quietly delay or dilute this law. Tell them: Shield civil society from corporate bullies!

2026-04-trial-circular-economy-trial-EN.title: EU: make products last!
2026-04-trial-circular-economy-trial-EN.description_full:
EU: make products last!

To the European Commission, EU Member States, and local and regional authorities

Petition

We call on you to:

  • Set strong EU rules that ensure products are designed to last longer and can be easily repaired
  • Make repairs affordable and accessible for everyone
  • Support cities and regions in scaling repair, reuse, and local circular systems
  • Reduce waste by prioritising reuse and long product lifetimes


Europe can move from a throwaway system to one that works for people, communities, and the planet. 

Why is this important?

Your phone breaks. You buy another. Companies profit, you pay. 

It’s not your fault. It’s by design.

Think about it. A screen that cracks easily. A washing machine that fails just after the warranty. Across Europe, products are made to be replaced - not to last. [1]

And the result? Bins overflowing. Drawers filled with dead devices. Cities struggling with the waste.

But right now, EU leaders are deciding on a new law that could finally change this. [2] 

Done right, it means products that last. Fixable devices that don't force you to buy again. Done wrong, we’ll be stuck in the same cycle: break, replace, pay - while greedy companies profit.

Cities and regions are ready to make this work - to support repairs, make products last and reduce waste. But without strong EU rules, we stay stuck in the same cycle - break, replace, pay. [3]

That’s where you come in.

If enough people speak up now, EU leaders are far more likely to stand up to corporate pressure - and back a law that works for us.

If you’re tired of paying again and again for products designed to fail, sign now to stop this cycle!

2026-04-trial-climate-protections-our-wi.title: Keep making polluters pay
2026-04-trial-climate-protections-our-wi.description_full:
Keep making polluters pay

To the European Parliament, European Commission, and EU Member State governments

Petition

Big polluters and their corporate lobbyists are attacking one of the EU’s most important climate policies: the Emissions Trading System.

They’ve succeeded at delaying the launch of the second phase of this scheme to make pollution more expensive. Worse, they’ve blocked billions of euros in support that should be helping people deal with higher energy and transport costs. 

What needs to be done: 

  • End fossil privileges. Stop delaying the introduction of the carbon price for road transport and buildings (ETS2), and don’t water it down.
  • Invest in real, lasting solutions. Every Euro counts to make homes warmer, communities healthier, and clean transportation affordable.
  • Put climate money to work for people. Expand the EU’s Social Climate Fund so support reaches those who need it most.

Why is this important?

Recently, this community secured a major victory: an ambitious climate target for Europe. Together, we pushed back against conservative and extremist forces - and won!

But this target is impossible to achieve if we stay hooked to fossil fuels.

We can incentivise companies to produce without using fossil fuels. This is called the ‘dirty industries pay’ scheme - and it works! Emissions have been cut by 50% in the energy and aviation sector. [1]

Now this successful scheme is to be expanded to other sectors, its enemies have put their well-oiled propaganda machines at work. A few days ago, they  called for it to be weakened and postponed for years.

A handful of countries are championing the ‘dirty industries pay’ scheme, but many others are pushing to shelve it indefinitely. [2]  With the final decision looming, we must urgently give more weight to those defending the scheme. 

Together, we can call out corporate cronies and force governments to choose the people over pollution - as we’ve done before! If we remain silent, the likes of Repsol, Eni or Total will continue to profit while polluting Europe. Take one minute to defend Europe’s climate progress!

2026-04-trial-energy-prices-windfall-tax.description_full:
Make Polluters Pay, Fund Renewables

To the European Commission, European Parliament and EU Heads of State.

Petition

We want a Europe that works for people, not for fossil fuel profits.

Time and again, crises push up energy, food, and everyday costs. Companies make billions, and ordinary people are left to pay the bill. This must change.

Make polluters and war profiteers pay and use that money to invest in reliable, cheap, homegrown energy which lowers bills and strengthens our future for people and planet.

Why is this important?

Yesterday, leaders confirmed it: Europe is heading into another energy price shock. [1]

Prices are rising again - and people are being told to cut back. Work from home. Travel less. Use less energy. Sound familiar? [2] 

In the last energy crisis, companies made huge profits while households struggled to keep up with rising bills. 

Fossil fuel companies don’t pay. It’s you and I who foot the bill - paying more for energy, food, and everyday life. [3]

One month into this senseless, illegal war, Shell, Total, and warmongers like Trump are cashing in billions. US-based ExxonMobil is on track for record-breaking profits, all from a war that destroys lives. [4]

It doesn’t have to be this way. EU leaders stepped in and taxed oil and gas giants profiting from the war in Ukraine - raising €30 billion to support people through the crisis. [5]

Now, as prices rise again, that solution is back on the table in EU discussions. [6] We need to make it a reality. 

Together, we can make polluters pay and use that money to protect people from price spikes and break free from fossil fuels. 

Let’s make sure the companies profiting from war pay, not people.

2026-04-trial-EU-Israel-trial-EN.title: No trade with executioners - suspend the EU-Israel deal!
2026-04-trial-EU-Israel-trial-EN.description_full:
No trade with executioners - suspend the EU-Israel deal!

To the EU leaders and foreign ministers 

Petition

We call on the European Union and its Member States to:

  • Suspend the EU-Israel Association Agreement immediately;
  • Halt all trade and financial relations with Israel until the death penalty is revoked and Palestinians’ rights are respected; 
  • Ensure that respect for human rights remains a non-negotiable condition for any EU trade agreement.

Why is this important?

Nothing seems to be off limits to Israel's genocidal leaders. From starving civilians to legalising the death penalty for Palestinians. [1]

And still, the European Union continues to be Israel’s biggest trading partner. And Italy is its third biggest arms supplier in the world. [2]

But finally, the tide is turning. 

Italy’s Giorgia Meloni has suspended the renewal of a 20-year defence agreement with Israel. [3]

That is huge.

And it’s not happening in isolation.

Orbán - who long blocked EU action - has just lost power. Belgium and Spain are pushing for sanctions on Israel. And across Europe pressure is rising - with over a million signatures and a new global flotilla setting sail to Gaza. [4]

Everything is pointing in the same direction: this is the moment.

As Israel escalates its human rights violations, pressure to suspend the EU-Israel deal is growing fast. 

In just two days, European leaders will meet in Brussels to decide what happens next. [5]

This is where you come in. 

A door is opening in Europe - and it could close just as quickly. We are ready to turn this moment into pressure on the leaders sitting in that room. But that only works if this community - people like you - cares enough. 

If you care about this, sign now!

2026-04-trial-green-data-centres-trial-p.description_full:
Make data centres in the EU run on 100% renewable energy!

To the European Commission, European Parliament and Council of the European Union

Petition

We ask you to pass legislation requiring all data centres in the European Union to be powered by 100% renewable energy

Why is this important?

Thousands of enormous, energy-hungry data centres, forcing up electricity prices for all of us. [1] That’s what risks happening unless we demand an alternative.

Data centres use huge amounts of energy. In Ireland alone, they already consume 20% of the country’s electricity. [2] Now, driven by skyrocketing AI use, the EU wants to triple its data centre capacity. [3] 

If energy use doesn’t change, our over-reliance on fossil fuels will plunge us into crisis after crisis. New data centres in Europe should only be built if they can be powered by renewable energy. We could fight climate change and bring down bills for everyone by making big tech companies invest in wind and solar. 

Decisions are being made in Brussels right now on how to make sure data centres are energy efficient. These decisions will have real impacts on our bills, our lives and our local communities. 

Our planet should be the priority, not AI company profits. We need decisionmakers to be bolder and require all data centres to run on 100% renewable energy.  

They need to know they have citizens behind them. Sign the petition now to tell the EU: Data centres must be powered by 100% renewable energy.

2026-04-trial-hunt-fraudsters-down-trial.title: Hunt fraudsters down!
2026-04-trial-hunt-fraudsters-down-trial.description_full:
Hunt fraudsters down!

To the European Commission, European Parliament and the Council of the European Union

Petition

Around €1 billion in public money is uncovered each year by the European Anti-Fraud Office - but real losses are far higher. Every euro recovered from fraud means more funding for energy bills, hospitals, schools. Yet oversight has not kept pace with expanding EU spending. As the EU negotiates its next budget, there is an opportunity to change this. 

We call on leaders to increase OLAF’s funding and strengthen its investigative capacity in the next EU budget. Recovering stolen public money is one of the most direct ways to protect citizens’ wallets.

Why is this important?

You paid for vehicles that save lives. Instead, someone bought himself a castle. 

Our taxes meant for better farming paid for luxury villas for businessmen. [1]

A huge amount of public money is stolen from us. [2] But chasing fraudsters isn’t a job for bureaucrats. It takes high spirits. Someone brave. 

Klement, a trusted ‘sheriff’ with real experience taking on the toughest mafia types, is now in charge of anti-fraud. His motto: ‘Hunt like dog packs: close the circle, then bite'. [3]

But to make sure our money isn’t stolen away from things we care about, Klement needs real backing for him and his team.

The EU only sets its budget every seven years. And this is happening right now. A rare chance to make sure there’s a well-funded, ambitious team to recover our money and stop fraud.

Powerful politicians are already pushing for more resources to crack down on fraudsters: but they need to know how important this is for people.

If we don’t speak up now, money that could make life better for us will end up in the pockets of mafia types. The window to shape the budget is closing. Take action to stop criminals stealing.

References:

Stop the next pandemic before it starts

To the European member states of the World Health Organisation

Petition

Agree to make the sharing of vaccines, diagnostics and therapeutics compulsory for all member states as part of the Pandemic Agreement. 

Why is this important?

Almost 200 countries are negotiating a once-in-a-generation deal to prevent another global catastrophe like COVID-19.

But right now, that chance is under threat.

Some of the richest countries in Europe are blocking the very measures that would make this historic pandemic agreement actually work.  

Pandemics don’t stop at borders. Without mandatory sharing of vaccines, technology, and knowledge, the world risks repeating the same deadly mistakes.

Rich European countries like Germany and Switzerland are demanding it stays voluntary. They're desperate to protect their powerful pharmaceutical sectors.[1]

Right now we have a rare window to change their minds. On May 18th, governments will meet to finalise the agreement, and they’re under pressure to get it over the line. [2]

So far these negotiations have gone under the radar and no one’s more happy about that than Big Pharma. If we can build pressure before the meeting, it will be a huge public embarrassment for them to keep blocking progress.

Add your name to demand mandatory vaccines and knowledge sharing - to stop the next global pandemic before it starts.

2026-04-trial-sexual-violence-online-pet.title: Stop platforms promoting sexual violence!
2026-04-trial-sexual-violence-online-pet.description_full:
Stop platforms promoting sexual violence!

To the European Commission and and national-level authorities known as Digital Services Coordinators

Petition

We’re calling on the European Commission and national authorities to:

- force Google, Yahoo and other search engines to stop indexing and promoting sites hosting sexual violence,
- ensure platforms remove and block access to this content at scale,
- use the Digital Services Act to hold companies accountable and protect women,
- close enforcement gaps that allow cross-border abuse networks to persist.

Why is this important?

More than 20,000 videos of women being raped while unconcious.

62 millions visits to a single website hosting these videos in just one month.

A CNN investigation uncovered what they called an “online rape academy”. A website where men share footage of sexual violence against unconscious women, and openly exchange instructions on how to commit it. [1]

They discuss sedatives and dosages. They advise each other on how to avoid detection. They upload videos of assaults, often filmed in their own homes.  

This is not hidden in the darkest corners of the internet. It’s accessible through mainstream platforms and can be found through search engines we use every day.

And it is not confined to one country. These networks operate across borders, including throughout Europe.

Platforms like Google, Yahoo and others recommend, and drive traffic to these sites.

This is how we stop it: cut visibility, cut traffic, cut profit. Europe already has a law that could help stop this - but right now, it’s not being used to protect women from this kind of abuse.

The European Commission can force search engines and platforms to stop leading people to these sites and cut off the traffic that keeps them alive. 

Every day this content remains online is another day violence is normalised, and allowed to continue. Add your name to help shut this down!

2026-04-trial-social-media-age-limit-pet.title: Keep our kids safe online
2026-04-trial-social-media-age-limit-pet.description_full:
Keep our kids safe online

To the European Commission, European Parliament and EU Heads of State.

Petition

Every child should be able to grow up safe - both offline and online.

But right now, social media platforms are designed to keep children scrolling, not to protect their wellbeing.

We are calling on EU leaders to step in and protect children from harmful online design.

We are calling for:

  • Strong EU-wide rules to protect children online, preventing exposure to harmful or age-inappropriate content
  • Limits on addictive platform design, including infinite scroll, autoplay, and engagement-driven feeds
  • Stronger safeguards for algorithmic feeds, so children are not pushed towards harmful or extreme content
  • Clear responsibility for platforms to protect children, not just maximise screen time or profit
  • Real enforcement when platforms fail to keep children safe, with meaningful penalties when harm occurs.

Why is this important?

Protecting kids online feels impossible. But now, things are changing - fast.

Courts are finally ruling against companies like Meta and YouTube. Governments across Europe are proposing age limits and tighter rules. [1]

For the first time, Big Tech is being held accountable.

Because the problem has been clear for years: social media companies designed their platforms to keep kids hooked. Infinite scroll. Autoplay. Algorithms. For children and teenagers, whose brains are still developing, these features can be impossible to resist. 

The consequences are devastating. Bullying on social media follows kids into their homes, long after school ends. Content drags them into eating disorders or self-harm spirals. [2] 

Social media is built to maximise profit, not safety. Some countries are finally taking it seriously and considering bans. [3]

But experts and evidence warns that banning specific social media platforms will just send them to other online spaces. [4] Unless platforms like TikTok and Meta are made safer by design, with EU-wide rules, enforcement, and monitoring, kids will be exposed to the same harm wherever they go. 

Hundreds of thousands of parents and citizens are already speaking up. [5] And now, with the courts on our side, people power can push Europe to go further - and force platforms to finally put children’s safety before profit.

Will you add your voice to make social media safer for kids?

2026-04-trial-stop-fossil-fuels-trial-EN.title: Break free from fossil fuels: end rising bills!
2026-04-trial-stop-fossil-fuels-trial-EN.description_full:
Break free from fossil fuels: end rising bills!

To the EU leaders and the European Commission

Petition

Europe can become energy independent, but only if we stop funding fossil fuels and invest in clean energy at home.

We call on the EU to:

  • phase out fossil fuel subsidies
  • invest in renewable energy, grids and storage
  • protect households from price shocks

Why is this important?

A war thousands of kilometres away decides how much you pay on your energy bill. 

Why is this happening again?

This is Europe’s second energy crisis in just four years - first Russia, now Iran. [1] Every time there’s a crisis, oil and gas prices jump. And a few weeks later, higher bills land in people’s homes because Europe still runs on imported fossil fuels. [2]

Right now, European leaders are in Cyprus deciding how to respond to this energy shock. [3]

They can keep spending billions on short-term fixes that don’t last. Or they can fix the root of the problem: invest in clean energy made in Europe - and stop relying on fuels we don’t control. [4]

But while they decide, fossil fuel lobbyists are in the room with them - pushing to keep us dependent on them.  

That’s where you come in. 

This decision is being shaped right now in Europe - and it could go either way. We’re ready to turn this moment into pressure on the leaders in that room. But that only works if people like you speak up. 

If you care about this, sign now and call on the EU to stop funding fossil fuel dependence! 

References:

2026-05-circular-economy-petition-EN.title: Longer life, lower costs!
2026-05-circular-economy-petition-EN.description_full:
English

  • Français
  • Deutsch
  • Español
  • Italiano
  • Nederlands
  • Polski

Longer life, lower costs!

To the European Commission, European Parliament, European Council, Member States, and local and regional authorities

Petition

We call on you to ensure the EU Circular Economy Act delivers a real shift towards a circular economy by:

  • Setting binding, science-based targets on resource use to reduce Europe’s material footprint within planetary boundaries
  • Setting binding reuse and repair targets, ensuring that EU policies deliver tangible waste prevention outcomes 
  • Harmonising and reforming Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) schemes through revisions of the Waste Framework Directive and WEEE Directive to focus on reuse and repair before recycling 
  • Requiring Member States to integrate repair and reuse infrastructure and services into national waste prevention plans.
  • Requiring the sorting and assessment of all collected used devices and e-waste items by qualified professionals to determine their reusability before recycling. 
  • Ensuring safe and transparent material cycles by removing harmful chemicals from products and improving traceability
  • Supporting cities and regions to scale local circular systems, repair networks, and reuse infrastructure

Why is this important?

You've probably got an old phone gathering dust in a drawer somewhere.

You meant to get it fixed. But repairing it was too expensive, too difficult, or simply impossible.

That’s not an accident. Companies like Apple and Samsung profit when we don’t repair and buy new instead. While mountains of electronic waste continue to grow, we pay the price. 

Right now, the EU is working on a new law to tackle this mountain of waste. It's called the Circular Economy Act. Done right, it would mean products built to last, and repair that’s easy and affordable. [1]

But there's a problem. Right now, the plans are all about recycling, and almost nothing about repair and reuse. That suits the industry fine: they'd rather you give up on your old phone and buy a new one. [2]

We can still turn this around, the law is being written as we speak. But only if enough of us raise our voices  now, will repair and reuse make it in. Sign today to demand a Circular Economy Act that puts repair and reuse at its heart!

100% renewable energy for EU data centres!

To the European Commission, the European Parliament and the Council of the European Union

Petition

We demand that:

  • All new data centres in Europe must meet their energy needs with 100% new, local and additional renewable energy
  • Companies must be required to be transparent about projected energy demand, actual energy consumption and per-site emissions for planned and existing data centres
  • No new data centres in Europe until they are made compatible with Europe's energy transition and climate goals

Why is this important?

Thousands of huge, energy-hungry data centres pushing up electricity prices for all of us. That's what could happen if we don't demand an alternative.

Data centres consume massive amounts of energy. In Ireland alone, they already use up 20% of the country's electricity. [1] Now, driven by the explosion in AI use, big tech companies want to build thousands more across Europe. [2]

New data centres in Europe should only be built if they can be powered by renewable energy. We could fight climate change and lower everyone's bills by forcing big tech to invest in wind and solar.

Decisions are being made in Brussels right now on how to ensure data centres are energy efficient. These decisions will have real impacts on our bills, our lives and our local communities.

Our planet must come first, not the profits of AI companies. We need decision-makers to go further and require all data centres to run on 100% new renewable energy.

2026-05-trial-cruiseship-ban-petition-EN.title: Ban megacruise ships
2026-05-trial-cruiseship-ban-petition-EN.description_full:
Ban megacruise ships

To the European Commission, European Parliament and EU governments

Petition

Megacruise ship traffic is increasing in Europe’s coastal cities, destroying public health, coastal cities, and marine environments.

We are calling on EU and national leaders to act to protect our health and coasts:

  • stronger monitoring and virus prevention measures on cruise ships to protect passengers, crew, and coastal communities
  • limits or bans on cruise ship traffic in environmentally sensitive areas and overcrowded coastal cities
  • stronger protections for cruise ship workers, including clear rights during outbreaks and emergencies

Why is this important?

Sunshine on the deck. Fresh sea air. Beautiful coastal cities passing by. Cruise companies sell the dream of a carefree escape.

But there’s an ugly side to megacruise tourism they don’t want people to see.

Recent virus outbreaks have once again exposed cruise ships as ideal environments for disease to spread. [1] 

And when they do, workers often pay the price. During the pandemic, thousands of cruise ship crew members were stranded onboard infected ships for months with little pay and few rights. [2] 

But the damage doesn’t stop there.

Giant cruise corporations like Carnival, MSC, and Royal Caribbean are turning some of Europe’s most beautiful cities into polluted, overcrowded hotspots. From Marseille to Barcelona, local people face overcrowded streets, damaged coastlines, and growing risks to their health. [3]

But cities are pushing back - and winning. Venice banned large cruise ships from entering its historic lagoon to stop pollution and ecosystem damage. [4] Cities like Amsterdam are calling for a similar ban. [5]

With momentum building, we can push back across Europe - before another decade of megacruise expansion is locked in. The more ports we can pressure to follow, the harder it will be for governments to allow megacruises in their cities.

Together, we can force our leaders to put our health, our workers, and our coastlines before cruise giants’ profits.

2026-05-trial-dont-send-data-to-trump-pe.title: No to US blackmail: Don’t give our data to Trump
2026-05-trial-dont-send-data-to-trump-pe.description_full:
No to US blackmail: Don’t give our data to Trump

To the European Commission, the European Parliament and the Member States of the EU

Petition

We call on you to: 

  • Withdraw and/or reject the “Framework Agreement between the European Union and the United States of America on the reciprocal exchange of information for identity verification, and screening and vetting, relating to border procedures and applications for travel authorizations and visas” in its current form.
  • Reject any agreement that does not properly safeguard the private data of Europeans

Why is this important?

Imagine attending a peaceful protest, and your fingerprints and facial images ending up in Trump’s hands. [1] 

Right now, the EU is quietly working on a deal that could give Trump and the US access to sensitive police databases across Europe. These databases contain information about completely innocent people - like protesters, activists and asylum seekers. 

If the EU doesn’t give in, the US Government is threatening to remove visa-free travel to the US.

Giving Trump access to our data in Europe, could put anyone who speaks out against him at risk. Trump has already arrested - and even defended the murder of - protesters in the US. [2]

Civil liberties organisations and some politicians are sounding the alarm. One MEP has called it “a clear case of blackmail”. [3] 

But so far, it’s received almost no attention at all. Few articles in newspapers, barely any social media posts. Because once people across Europe learn what’s happening, public outrage could spread fast. And that pressure could stop this deal. 

Tell the EU: NO to US blackmail. NO to giving Trump access to our fingerprints and facial images.

Stop the phone hackers

To the European Commission, European Parliament and Council of the European Union

Petition

We call on the EU to stop funding or investing in phone hacking technology or spyware from Israeli companies and the wider commercial spyware industry. Public money must never be used to support tools that can monitor journalists, activists, migrant-rights defenders, or ordinary people through their own phones. The EU must ban commercial spyware, cut all financial ties to the industry behind it, and protect people across Europe from unlawful digital surveillance.

Why is this important?

Right now, someone could read your messages, watch through your camera or track you. All without you knowing. [1] 

In Europe, people helping migrants or exposing far-right lies can now be monitored on their phones - just like under Trump. [2] 

Israeli corporations are making billions from cutting-edge phone hacking - exploiting their expertise in war and repression. [3]

It gets worse: a new scandal just revealed that the EU is funding this Israeli tech to monitor people like you and me. [4] And they refuse to stop.

Journalists are starting to expose this tech. Inside Parliament some are calling for a ban. Momentum is building around the scandal - but it could vanish fast.

Backing these lone voices up now with hundreds of thousands of signatures will give them the push they need to fight for a law that protects us. 

Every time the counter goes up, we push the hackers away from our private lives.

2026-05-trial-millions-of-jobs-trial-EN.description_full:
Stop AI from taking our jobs

To the European Commission, European Parliament and Council of the European Union

Petition

Europe cannot afford an AI race that leaves workers behind. As the EU reviews its AI rules, protections risk being weakened. Unchecked industrial AI will speed up automation and limit job opportunities. Without strong safeguards, we face fewer stable jobs, rising inequality, and millions having a hard time staying employed.

Protect and strengthen - not dilute - the AI Act. New rules must safeguard workers’ rights, job quality, and access to work. Europe’s digital future must create opportunities, not close the door on workers.

Why is this important?

Just last year, 100 000 people were fired because of artificial intelligence (AI). [1] 

Instead of defending workers, politicians plan to weaken the rules that protect our jobs from AI - making it easier for companies to replace people. [2]

Millions of livelihoods are at risk: from management to manual jobs.

From drivers, shop attendants, teachers, designers, bankers, to office workers. [3] 

Our leaders think we are not paying attention. That they can quietly strip away protections, unleash AI and boost corporate profits, while working people pay the price. 

But they’re wrong. Because before decisions are made in the shadows, our community shows up.

When we show up in thousands across Europe, we put their decisions in the spotlight, and make it risky for them to choose corporate profits over our jobs.

If we stay silent, we risk a future with fewer stable jobs, and millions pushed out of work. Save jobs for humans!

2026-05-trial-private-jets-trial-EN.title: EU: Ban private jets!
2026-05-trial-private-jets-trial-EN.description_full:
EU: Ban private jets!

To the European Commission, EU energy ministers, and EU Member States

Petition

We call on you to introduce an EU-wide ban on private jet flights, starting with an immediate ban on non-essential flights during the energy crisis - and to lead by example by stopping the use of private jets within EU institutions.

Why is this important?

“The cheapest energy is the one you don’t use”, said the EU Commission President Ursula von der Leyen to Europeans. [1]

But while she wants us to cut back, she keeps flying with private jets - even between Brussels and Luxembourg. A journey that takes about two and a half hours by car. [2]

And it gets worse. The EU increased spending on private jets by 50% - knowing they’re among the most polluting forms of transport. [3]

Now Europe faces another energy crisis. Prices are rising again. Airlines warn that flights may be cancelled due to fuel shortages. And thousands of people like you and me may not be able to afford their ONE week of holiday this year. [4]

People across Europe are furious, and why some Members of the European Parliament are now calling for a temporary ban on private jets. [5]

But temporary is not enough. We want a full ban on private jets. And the timing couldn't be better. Next week, EU energy ministers meet to discuss measures for the current energy crisis. A ban on private jets could be part of the package.[6] 

But only if enough of us speak out NOW and make sure our representatives know that Europeans expect fairness, not special treatment for the wealthy and powerful. Sign now to demand a ban on private jets!

2026-05-trial-social-media-age-limit-pet.title: Keep our kids safe online
2026-05-trial-social-media-age-limit-pet.description_full:
Keep our kids safe online

To the European Commission, European Parliament and EU Heads of State.

Petition

Digital products from social media to games and AI chatbots are deliberately designed to keep children and young people hooked, influence their thinking and manipulate their behaviour. This is damaging their health, development and relationships.

Politicians are finally taking notice, but too often their answers are overly simplistic, limited to social media and put the burden on children and parents. Instead, they need to take on the companies breaking the law.

Our children are growing up in a digital world that prioritises profit over their health, safety and well-being. Instead of empowering future generations to thrive, tech corporations are exploiting, endangering, and isolating children.

Our children, families and communities deserve better. We are calling on you to act now:.

  • Put safety at the heart of design. Make child safety certification a pre-requisite for all tech used by kids.
  • Protect under 13s from manipulation. Enforce a legal ban on personalised services for under 13s.
  • Mandate age-tiered access and support guardrails for all under 18s that evolve as they grow.
  • Ban services that do not comply. Use EU market access powers to restrict services that expose children to risk and harm.

Why is this important?

“At first, TikTok was just fun.” Maëlle downloaded the app at 14 years old, scrolling through to distract herself from the bullying she experienced at school.

“And then, little by little, it became darker and darker. It kept my head underwater. The more I watched, the deeper I sank.”

Her parents had no idea what she was seeing. Neither did her doctors. By 2022, she had been hospitalised.  

Maëlle is one of many children who’ve been hurt by these platforms. [1]

Social media bosses want to maximise screen time and profit, even when it harms children. Infinite scroll. Autoplay. Algorithms that learn a young person’s insecurities, then push dangerous content to keep them hooked.

Governments are finally listening to children like Maëlle. Courts are ruling against platforms like Meta and YouTube. Some countries are proposing bans and age limits. [2]

But experts warn bans alone won’t keep children safe. Unless platforms themselves are made safer by design, they will continue to face the same harmful features elsewhere online. [3]

Parents and citizens are already speaking up. We need strong rules that force social media companies to protect children - not trap them in addictive and harmful feeds.

Now, with the courts on our side, people power can push Europe to go further. Will you add your voice to make social media safer for kids? [4]

References:

[3] Experts, human rights groups, and more than 30 youth organisations across Europe warn that bans alone will not protect children- and that platforms themselves must be made safer by design. https://www.brusselstimes.com/belgium/2089712/youth-organisations-demand-social-media-change-not-bans ; https://apnews.com/article/australia-social-media-ban-children-58c50c845d96057b39529e988bd778bc ; https://www.theguardian.com/media/2025/feb/22/social-media-bans-for-teens-australia-has-passed-one-should-other-countries-follow-suit ; https://www.coe.int/en/web/commissioner/-/regulate-platforms-not-children-council-of-europe-commissioner-for-human-rights-urges-caution-over-social-media-bans

2026-05-trial-yes-means-yes-trial-EN.title: EU: Only Yes means Yes!
2026-05-trial-yes-means-yes-trial-EN.description_full:
EU: Only Yes means Yes!

To the European Commission and EU Member States

Petition

We call on you to: 

  • introduce an EU-wide law that defines rape based on consent - making clear that only yes means yes. 
  • ensure that all EU countries adopt a consent-based definition of rape, and to close the legal gaps that fail survivors.

Why is this important?

Do you remember Gisèle Pelicot? [1]

For years, Gisèle’s husband, Dominique, drugged her - and invited dozens of men to rape her while she was unconscious. [2] 

When the truth came out, she chose to speak publicly. 

She spoke out for the millions of women across Europe - around 1 in 3 - who experience violence. Only a few are believed. [3]

Gisèle’s case raises a simple question: Why does the law still ask survivors to prove they resisted - instead of asking whether they agreed?

In parts of Europe, that is still how rape is defined. [4]

But just days ago, the European Parliament opened a window for change. Lawmakers proposed an updated definition: only “yes” means consent. [5]

This window won’t stay open for long.

Right now, the European Commission is deciding whether this becomes law.

Gisèle Pelicot spoke out. Now it’s up to us to join her. Because together, our voices become impossible to ignore. Sign now to make sure only yes means yes - for everyone in Europe! 

References:

[1] [2] https://www.lemonde.fr/en/global-issues/article/2026/02/11/gisele-pelicot-publishes-memoirs-after-mass-rape-trial_6750362_199.html ; https://www.bbc.com/afrique/articles/cjd9emv3e8zo
